_about: Custom monster types (guide section 28). A key is the type's name: a-z, 0-9 and _, starting with a letter. 'like' is the only required key; everything left out comes from it. This mod ships no sprites, so the imp walks and shows as a tinted goblin (the like's art). A real mod adds idle, walk, icon, heads (4 frames) and infant_head strips, see README.txt.

imp._about: A small goblin-like raider: weaker in the front row, fast, light eater.
imp.name: Imp
